summary: Verified alpha.37 backend fixes for the two merchant bugs via live HTTP tests against the preview backend. All 6 requested scenarios pass, plus native_mode sanity. Created /app/backend/tests/test_alpha37_live_integration.py (7 tests, all green). Pre-existing unit suite test_alpha37_presentation_and_files_tabs.py also re-verified (6/6 green).
critical_code_review_comments: presentations.py import_trivia now double-writes: inserts into db.trivia_presentations AND db.presentations (with type=trivia-imported). The list-merge dedupes by id, so the same id appears once — correct behaviour but worth documenting that the two collections purposely share ids.

files_router.py files_list() no longer requires auth. Confirmed via requirement note that this matches desktop-only usage. Consider adding a lightweight local-only guard in future to prevent enumeration of on-disk slugs from the preview URL.

presentations import-trivia uses FAST_SLIDE_COUNT env default of 'true' so slide counts are estimates (12/round). Fine for wizard save, but /api/presentations totalSlides values are estimates rather than real counts — merchant expectations should be aligned.
seed_data_creation: Per-run tag TEST_alpha37_<hex8>: one imported trivia presentation in db.trivia_presentations + db.presentations, and one TEST_Loc_<hex8> location (deleted on teardown). Presentation docs are not cleaned up — safe because createdBy is namespaced with the TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live HTTP integration test file /app/backend/tests/test_alpha37_live_integration.py is reusable — uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and Sellards@bighat.live credentials from test_credentials.md. Bug #1 verified: POST /api/presentations/import-trivia writes to trivia_presentations and GET /api/presentations?userName=X (with or without viewAll) returns the id. Bug #2 verified: /api/native/files?folder=Locations returns type=location entries with '1 branding, 1 overlays' summary; /api/native/files?folder=Hosts lists host subfolders; no folder param → aggregate list has NO location/host bleed.
rca of the issue: Bug 1 root cause: import_trivia wrote presentations to db.trivia_presentations, but get_presentations only read from db.presentations. Alpha.37 fix at presentations.py:69-110 queries both collections with case-insensitive createdBy regex and dedupes by id. Bug 2 root cause: files_list globbed for *.bighat, but Locations/Hosts store PNG/JPG image folders (branding/, overlays/), so the tabs were legitimately empty. Alpha.37 fix at files_router.py:984-1041 short-circuits canonical in ('Locations','Hosts') to enumerate subfolders with branding/overlay image counts and type='location'|'host' shape.
